_finding: Aerodrome's quote on Base is read from its own contracts (docs/simulate-buy-tz.md §3.1, outside review of #266): a Quoter is used only while its factory() is the pinned factory; a pool whose quote reverts, stops at the price limit (input left over) or answers anything but the Quoter's four words is skipped, and only confirmed absence is no_route; the base fee comes from the block header.

mutations.name: the pairing check is removed
mutations.find: if (addrOf(res[0]) !== deployment.factory) return out({ result: 'unknown', reason: 'quoter_mismatch' })
mutations.expect: FAIL a quoter whose factory() is another factory gives quoter_mismatch

mutations.name: a reverted pool quote is read
mutations.find:
if (!q.success) { reverted++; return }
    if (!HEX_WORDS(q.data, 4)) { unreadable++; return }
mutations.expect: FAIL a pool whose quote reverts is skipped, never zero

mutations.name: a quote that stopped at the price limit is taken
mutations.expect: FAIL a pool whose quote stopped at the price limit

mutations.name: an unreadable answer is called no route
mutations.find: if (!best) return unreadable ? out({ result: 'unknown', reason: 'quote_empty', pools, routerPaired }) : out({ result: 'no_route', pools, routerPaired })
mutations.replace: if (!best) return out({ result: 'no_route', pools, routerPaired })
mutations.expect: FAIL a successful answer that is not the Quoter

mutations.name: the base fee is made up when the header has none
mutations.expect: FAIL the base fee comes from the block header

mutations.name: a failed getPool is read as no pool
mutations.expect: FAIL a failed getPool read is unreadable
